lines.t: [sustained piano chords, ambient electric guitar swells]
[Verse 1]
I lay my burden at your feet
You are mercy, you are sweet
When the night was close and I could not see
Your voice of truth was calling me
I was wandering, I was worn
But you found me in the storm
You spoke peace into my fear
And now I know that you are near
[Chorus]
You are holy, you are near
I bow in awe, I bow in fear
You are worthy, you are light
The darkness trembles at your sight
I worship you, spirit and truth
My heart is yours, my life is proof
My king, my song, my endless praise
I will dwell in your holy ways
I lift my voice, I lift my hands
I surrender to your plans
Forevermore my soul will sing
All honor to my righteous king
[Verse 2]
You broke the chains that held my soul
You made the wounded spirit whole
You called me out of heaviness
And wrapped me in your tenderness
Every scar and every tear
You have turned them into cheer
Now every breath and every day
Belongs to you, I give you praise
[Chorus]
You are holy, you are near
I bow in awe, I bow in fear
You are worthy, you are light
The darkness trembles at your sight
I worship you, spirit and truth
My heart is yours, my life is proof
My king, my song, my endless praise
I will dwell in your holy ways
I lift my voice, I lift my hands
I surrender to your plans
Forevermore my soul will sing
All honor to my righteous king
[Bridge]
In the quiet of the night
You become my guiding light
When the world is loud and vain
You remain the same, the same
I will see your face above
I will rest inside your love
Teach me how to walk your way
Lead me in your truth each day
[Chorus]
You are holy, you are near
I bow in awe, I bow in fear
You are worthy, you are light
The darkness trembles at your sight
My king, I lift my eyes
You reign forever high and high
My king, take all I am
I surrender to the lamb
Yeshua, hear my song
You were faithful all along
Yeshua, take the throne
Let your glory be made known
